headline: BTC surges past $81k, eyes next resistance as liquidity dries up
btc_thesis: On the 1H chart BTC holds a higher low at ~79.2k and is testing the 4H upward channel, with the 79.5k‑80k zone acting as fresh liquidity support.
altcoin_summary: Altcoins are rotating into high‑beta assets; ONE, G, STRK and F lead with >35% gains, reflecting risk‑on sentiment after Bitcoin’s breakout.
strategy_outlook: Enter spot BTC on pull‑backs to the 79.5k‑80k support zone with a tight stop; for futures, consider long entries above 81.5k with a trailing stop at 80k.
